title: Contractual Denials on a Reviewed Remittance (Insulin Pump Program Denial Code Clause)
content:
**Clause.** In the review of a remittance posting on an Insulin Pump Program, what comes off for contractual denials follows the denials answering the remittance's claim:

- **CO-151.** Where a CO-151 denial answers it, the denied units, as the payer denied them, times the value of a denied unit are taken off the member responsibility.
- **CO-29.** Where a CO-29 denial answers it — the claim's filing limit having passed — the whole member responsibility is taken off.
- **Otherwise** nothing is taken off.

A CO-151 denial decides the deduction even where a CO-29 denial also answers the claim.

| Hypothetical remittance (member responsibility $41.10) | Taken off |
|---|---|
| CO-151 denial; 5 denied units valued at $6.85 | $34.25 |
| CO-29 denial only | $41.10 |
| No CO-151 or CO-29 denial | nothing |
